title: Stuck jobs
description: Active root jobs with a task waiting over 15 minutes — oldest PENDING task un-dispatched, or oldest ASSIGNED/BUILDING task not yet RUNNING — across the CoreWeave fleet, latest iris.task_state snapshot within the last 2 minutes. A non-zero value is the queue-saturation signal; the Jobs dashboard names them.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT root_job_id, GREATEST(oldest_pending_age_ms, oldest_building_age_ms) AS age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(cluster,''), root_job_id ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM "iris.task_state" WHERE root_job_id <> '' AND ts >= {{from}} AND ts < {{to}}) SELECT COUNT(*) AS stuck FROM r WHERE rn = 1 AND age > 900000
